difficulty.notes: AngularJS app. Anchor is the login submit handler $scope.doLogin@329 in login/js/controllers.js (the answer recorded in 1.json, label controllers.js:345). It calls the generic base64 encoder base64Encode (Core utility 0.5), which is defined cross-file in js/app.min.js. controllers.js contains FOUR near-identical $scope.doLogin handlers (lines 329/799/1484/1893) for different login flows; only @329 drives the captured POST /login, so the anchor is pinned by explicit offsets and the other three are registered as off-chain lookalike decoys. The construction path is graded across tiers: loginService.login (service.js, login request builder) 0.7, base64Encode (app.min.js, base64 primitive) 0.5, $iq_http.http (app.min.js, generic transport) 0.2. Vendor noise: angular/jquery/bootstrap/moment libraries under lib/.

task_contract.anchor_definition: The login submit handler $scope.doLogin@329 (captured as the 1.json answer): it reads the credentials, base64-encodes the password and assembles + sends the POST /login carrying the observed token. Graded below it on the construction path: loginService.login (the dedicated /login request builder, 0.7) -> base64Encode (generic base64 primitive producing the token bytes, 0.5) -> $iq_http.http (generic ajax transport/sink, 0.2). Off-chain (0): the inverse decoder base64Decode and the three sibling doLogin flows.

behavior_category.subtype: base64 of raw password as the request password field

near_categories.why_not: Only one scalar field is encoded; the request body is not wholesale rewritten/encrypted.
The token is a deterministic encoding of user input, not a device/browser capability digest.

evidence: The anchor handler (controllers.js) reaches its base64 encoder cross-file by name in a differently-named bundle (js/app.min.js); the agent must follow the call across files to confirm the password encoding.
Four near-identical $scope.doLogin handlers and many base64Encode call sites; vendor libraries add large generic noise.

provenance.label_points_to: the doLogin@329 handler body (the anchor); line 345 is the password: base64Encode(password) assignment inside it
